title: Association Grand Raid de la Réunion — Race Rules (2013 English version)
claims: The archived 2013 rules describe the Diagonale des Fous as an ultra trail of about 165 km with a total uphill climb of 9,900 m.
The 2013 rules say the course crosses Réunion diagonally from south to north, skirts the Piton de la Fournaise and goes across the cirques of Cilaos, Mafate and Salazie.
The 2013 rules say the route mostly follows regular long-distance footpaths and starts at Saint-Pierre, Ravine Blanche.
The 2013 rules set a maximum time of 65 hours for that edition.
